_comment: Posters and billboards around the city. How to add one in plain words: posters/README.md. Each poster: id (unique), image (a file in the posters/ folder), shape (wide = 2:1, 16:9, tall = 2:3 — it only appears in slots of that shape), link (opens in a new tab when the player taps the poster; leave empty for none), startDate / endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, both days included; empty = no limit), districts ('all' or a list of district ids from data/districts.json), weight (bigger = shown more often), active (false hides it). Empty slots show the default poster of their shape (settings.defaults). Loaded through the Content Service, so this list can later come from a Google Sheet.
